## Bio

Hi, my name is Surafel! I am a third year statistics and data science student at UT Austin, also pursuing the Programming and Computation certificate. I am currently doing research on sensitivity analysis methods for surrogate marker validation, and some of my other research interests are econometrics and causal inference in observational settings. In my free time, I enjoy cooking, watching movies, and reading.

## Education

**The University of Texas at Austin** | Austin, TX

B.S. in Statistics and Data Science | August 2024 - Present

## Research Experience

**LP Lab, UT Austin** | Undergraduate Research Assistant | February 2026 - Present
